item.title: AI Category Recommendation System for Drupal 11 Using PHP and OpenAI
item.description: In Drupal, choosing the right category for a page or article is very important. However, in real life, people can make mistakes. Editors may pick the wrong category, use different categories for similar content, or publish posts quickly without giving much thought to categorization. AI-powered Drupal 11 can now recommend the best category for a node. Instead of depending only on keywords, this recommendation is based on the node's actual content. For more information: https://www.phpcmsframework

item.title: Speed Up Syncthing File Sync Discovery (From 11 Seconds to 2)
item.description: New files were taking 11 seconds to sync from my Linux box to my Mac. That's an eternity when you're iterating on code or config. The fix took 30 seconds. The Problem Syncthing uses filesystem watchers to detect changes. When a file changes, the watcher notices, Syncthing scans it, and sync begins. But there's a built-in delay before Syncthing acts on watcher events. The default fsWatcherDelayS is 10 seconds. item.title: Basta con il "Funziona sulla mia Macchina": La Guida Semplice a Docker
item.description: In Breve (TL;DR) Docker risolve il classico problema del "funziona sulla mia macchina" creando ambienti di sviluppo, test e produzione perfettamente identici e portatili.
